units.title: Reading Hebrew
units.summary: Letters, vowels and syllables, then whole lines from the prayers. Start here if Hebrew letters are new to you, or skip ahead.

units.title: The parts every student leads
units.summary: The Sh’ma, the V’ahavta, and the blessings before and after the Torah and haftarah readings. Most students lead all six.

units.title: Morning blessings
units.summary: From waking up to the call to prayer: Modeh Ani, the tallit, Mah Tovu, the morning blessings and the verses of song.

units.title: The Sh’ma and its blessings
units.summary: Bar’chu calls us together. Two blessings lead to the Sh’ma, and Mi Chamochah carries us toward the Amidah.

units.title: The Amidah
units.summary: The standing prayer: seven blessings on Shabbat, from our ancestors to peace, then a moment of silence.

units.title: The Torah service
units.summary: Taking out the Torah, the readings, the healing prayer, and returning the scroll to the ark.

units.title: Closing the service
units.summary: Aleinu, the Mourner’s Kaddish, Adon Olam and the blessings that send us out.
